name.value: Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Vancouver-Downtown

description.value: The Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Vancouver-Downtown is a full-service hotel located on Robson Street in the heart of downtown Vancouver, one of the city's main pedestrian and shopping corridors. As part of the Hilton family of brands, it offers suite-style rooms suited to extended stays. Its central location places touring cyclists within easy reach of the Stanley Park Seawall, the False Creek cycling network, and urban services along Robson.
